title: Boy at Dinner Table, 1967 Vintage Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot capturing a young boy seated at a dining table with a plate of food and a glass of water in front of him. The background features retro fruit-patterned wallpaper, an electrical outlet, and a ruffled sheer lace curtain. The photo border is scalloped with a print date stamp on the right side reading 'APR . 67'. It provides a glimpse into mid-century American domestic home life during the late 1960s.
